blurb: Guests experience tandem skydives with expert instructors, including a 15-20 minute plane ride to 2 miles altitude, 40-60 seconds free fall, and a 4-6 minute parachute ride with scenic views. Licensed skydivers can rent gear and jump if they meet USPA currency requirements. Training courses are available to earn the USPA A license for solo skydiving.
